cases.source_title: NSF PMIC Center Overview and Research Focus

summary.zh: 围绕消费电子、工业设备和汽车的电能转换，研究高频无源器件、磁性材料与高功率密度变换器，将器件、电路和封装联合设计。达特茅斯侧重无源器件与集成，加州大学圣迭戈分校侧重高密度电源转换、能量采集和功率半导体。
summary.en: PMIC combines component, circuit and packaging research for power conversion in consumer, industrial and automotive applications. Dartmouth contributes passive-component and integration expertise; UC San Diego contributes high-density converters, energy harvesting and power-semiconductor research.

value.zh: 器件设计与电路封装协同
高温、恶劣环境与电磁干扰
value.en: High temperature, harsh environments and electromagnetic interference

cases.source_title: NSF CITES Center Overview and Research Focus

title.zh: 能源系统基础设施可信性研究中心（CITES）
title.en: Center for Infrastructure Trustworthiness in Energy Systems (CITES)

summary.zh: 针对电网等能源基础设施的网络攻击，研究入侵检测、受攻击时维持运行及事后恢复。伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳香槟分校、阿肯色大学和佛罗里达国际大学连接能源企业、国家实验室与行业组织，结合形式化分析和原型试验研究运行技术系统安全。
summary.en: CITES studies attack detection, continued operation and recovery in energy infrastructure. Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Arkansas and Florida International University connect with energy providers, national laboratories and industry associations, combining formal analysis with prototype evaluation for operational-technology security.

value.zh: 能源运行技术系统及其与信息技术设备的连接
value.en: Energy operational technology and its interaction with IT equipment

value.zh: 伊利诺伊大学运行技术系统试验平台

cases.source_title: NSF WindSTAR Research Focus and Awards

title.zh: 风能科学技术与研究中心（WindSTAR）
title.en: Center for Wind Energy Science, Technology and Research (WindSTAR)

summary.zh: 马萨诸塞大学洛厄尔分校与得克萨斯大学达拉斯分校围绕陆上和海上风电的设计、运行与维护开展联合研究，连接整机、零部件和开发运营环节。研究重点包括复合材料叶片、尾流控制、结构损伤监测、基础塔架及储能并网。
summary.en: UMass Lowell and UT Dallas connect turbine, component and project-development sectors through research on onshore and offshore wind design, operation and maintenance. Topics include composite blades, wake control, structural monitoring, foundations and storage integration.

value.zh: 激光雷达测量与风场模型验证
value.en: LiDAR measurements and wind-farm model validation

facts.locator: Research Focus — Wind farm modeling and measurement campaign

value.zh: 面向风能研究的大试验段边界层与亚声速风洞
value.en: Instrumented boundary-layer and subsonic wind tunnel

cases.source_title: NSF BEST Research Focus and Awards

title.zh: 建筑能源智能技术中心（BEST）

summary.zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校与纽约市立学院把建筑围护结构、机电设备、分布式能源和电网控制放在同一系统中研究。面向新建与既有建筑，连接城市尺度能源分析、需求响应和现场传感，研究兼顾能效、极端天气适应及使用者隐私的运行方案。
summary.en: Colorado Boulder and City College of New York study building envelopes, mechanical and electrical systems, distributed energy and grid control together. Work connects city-scale analysis, demand response and sensing for new and existing buildings, including extreme-weather operation and occupant privacy.

value.zh: 建筑设计、改造、建设与运行
value.en: Building design, retrofit, construction and operation

value.zh: 室内外能量流、需求响应与分布式能源数据
value.en: Indoor–outdoor energy flows, demand response and distributed-energy data

cases.source_title: NSF GRAPES Research Focus and Award 1939124

title.zh: 并网先进电力电子系统中心（GRAPES）
title.en: Center for Grid-Connected Advanced Power Electronic Systems (GRAPES)

summary.zh: 阿肯色大学与威斯康星大学密尔沃基分校采用从器件到电网的研究路径，连接功率模块、控制软件和配电系统，研究可再生能源接入、交直流微电网及固态保护。教授、学生与产业专家共同开展研发，试验设施支持原型及商业级电力电子设备测试。
summary.en: Arkansas and Wisconsin–Milwaukee connect power modules, control software and distribution systems using a device-to-grid approach. Faculty, students and industry experts study renewable integration, AC/DC microgrids and solid-state protection, with facilities for prototype and commercial-grade equipment tests.

value.zh: NCREPT试验设施6 MVA，可进行15 kV测试
value.en: NCREPT: 6 MVA facility with 15 kV testing capability

cases.source_title: NSF CEPS Research Focus and University Awards

title.en: Center for Solid-State Electric Power Storage (CEPS)

summary.zh: 南达科他矿业理工学院、美国东北大学和雪城大学围绕固态电池材料与制造开展合作，研究固态及聚合物电解质、锂金属负极保护层和电极界面传输，并延伸至电池回收和提锂。研究连接原位表征、原子尺度建模与制造工艺，不将研发目标视为已量产性能。
summary.en: South Dakota Mines, Northeastern and Syracuse collaborate on solid-state battery materials and manufacturing. Research covers electrolytes, lithium-metal protection and interface transport, alongside recycling and lithium extraction. It connects in-situ characterisation, atomic-scale modelling and manufacturing; research aims are not production performance.

value.zh: 三维打印与超音速冷喷涂沉积
便携设备、汽车与电网储能
value.en: Portable devices, automotive and grid storage
